```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Read data
```{r packages}
Niger_raw <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Niger/MTF_HH_Characteristics.dta")
```

## Yoink data we want
```{r packages}
Niger_filtered <- Niger_raw[,c(1,8,9,10,12,14,13,20,22,26,29,31,43,80,85,86,87,106,105,113,358,363,371,372,373,379,392)]
```

## Save as csv
```{r packages}
write.csv(Niger_filtered, "Data/Processed/Niger_filtered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
